title: A live blog of Samsung's Galaxy Unpacked in London, where the company is set to unveil its latest lineup of foldables and smartwatches (Engadget)
summary: Engadget: A live blog of Samsung's Galaxy Unpacked in London, where the company is set to unveil its latest lineup of foldables and smartwatches — We're reporting live from the company's event in London, UK. — It's time for Samsung to properly unveil its latest lineup of foldables and smartwatches at its Unpacked event today.
